prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / text-localization. Edit target: the supplied five-publication shared Substack banner. Add the publication weekday to each group while preserving the existing five folded logos, colors, names, pale pastel shapes, ivory background and thin sage separators. Keep the exact current left-to-right order and all existing publication names unchanged. Add a clearly readable third line directly BELOW the two-line publication name in each group, aligned with the left edge of the name: AI = 'MONDAY'; Obsidian = 'TUESDAY'; Skills = 'WEDNESDAY'; Crypto = 'THURSDAY'; HN = 'FRIDAY'. These five weekday words must be spelled exactly, each appearing once. Set the weekday line in a clean bold sans-serif, about half the publication-name font size, with moderate letter spacing and the corresponding logo color for each group (blue, purple, raspberry, green, orange). Preserve the original strong hierarchy: logo and publication name remain prominent; the weekday is a distinct readable secondary line. Adjust only the name block's vertical positioning slightly if needed to fit the weekday; preserve existing logo identity, relative scale and equal column widths. Keep all artwork fully inside a single centered horizontal band that can be cropped to a 5.1:1 final banner. If output is a 3:1 canvas, leave sufficient blank ivory above and below, with all essential logos, names, and weekday labels within the central 55 percent of height. Final intended use is a small website header and email banner, so the weekday words should be legible rather than decorative tiny captions. No new family-title block, no dates or times, no slogan, no extra symbols, no weekday pills or cards, no border, no watermark, no UI. Do not omit or duplicate any of the five publications.
